title: Take over operations after closing
summary: Transfer utilities, service contracts, tenant notices, rents and records on day one.
outlineSteps: Collect the rent roll, leases and service contracts at closing
Transfer utilities and service accounts to the new owner
Send tenants the new owner's notice and payment instructions
Set up rent and reimbursement billing from each lease
Confirm insurance is in force and meets the lender's requirements
Keep or cancel each service contract
Load the reserve schedule and the capital items found in diligence
File the property records where the team can find them
